comment: Hand-written cases outside the trace fixtures. Every trace in tests/fixtures/harness*/ is a case 'trace/<name>' added by the generator. Kinds: official_trace (recorded on the official server and replayed by Circuit), black_box (the same client script against the official server and Circuit, outputs compared), real_client (the unmodified client against Circuit only), round_trip (data through the official server and back), planned (an acceptance case with no expectation recorded yet).

cases.location: external: circuit-clienttest/packet-probe.js with weather-compare.txt, weather-join2.txt and (official only) weather-probe.txt, weather-timers.txt and weather-clear1.txt; Circuit's side also in tests/server/server_tests.cpp
cases.description: 16 /weather commands and a doWeatherCycle change, each from settled levels (rain, clear spells ending in thunderstorms, the cycle stopped, malformed durations), and a player joining in the rain: Circuit's 1,348 replies and game events per segment, every rain and thunder level value included, are identical with each official server's. The official servers' saved level data showed what each command does to the timers
